item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a wind-down built in: dinner early, progressive muscle relaxation at 8:30, and bedtime at 10:15. That's a solid structure, but it only works if the hour before bed stays calm. Keep screens dim and low-stimulation after relaxation. Don't use that time to plan tomorrow or replay today. Your sleep tonight sets up tomorrow's patience and focus. Action: tonight, put your phone down when the relaxation starts.
